summary: Black Myth entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Black Myth Wukong
entries.definitive_edition: Windows version on high-end RTX PC

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; no emulator required.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC native 4K/high settings with full ray tracing/path tracing and DLSS/Frame Generation as needed

primary.version: Windows version / Digital Deluxe content optional
primary.why: Sami chose PC. The 2024 Windows and PlayStation 5 releases exist, and there is a later Xbox Series X/S release. PC is the highest-fidelity route because full ray tracing/path tracing and DLSS are supported on PC; no platform-exclusive story content exists on PS5 or Xbox.
primary.how_to_play: Use the patched Windows build on the RTX 5090-class machine, target native 4K capture, and tune full ray tracing/path tracing plus DLSS/Frame Generation for stable recording. Digital Deluxe is optional cosmetics/soundtrack-style content, not a separate story route in the sourced data.

entries.remaster_caveats: Not a remaster. Public release references had not reflected Xbox in the opened page during this pass; Xbox Series availability was confirmed separately.
